```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
# Read market and topic tables into memory
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

# Join outcomes onto daily snapshots, then compute accuracy distance, days remaining, and horizon
joined <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet") |>
  left_join(markets, by = "market_id") |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    abs_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_remaining = as.integer(as_date(resolved_at) - date),
    time_bucket = factor(
      case_when(
        days_remaining == 0 ~ "Final day",
        days_remaining <= 7 ~ "1-7 days",
        days_remaining <= 30 ~ "7-30 days",
        days_remaining <= 90 ~ "30-90 days",
        days_remaining > 90 ~ "> 90 days"
      ),
      levels = c("> 90 days", "30-90 days", "7-30 days", "1-7 days", "Final day")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Summarize mean prediction error and snapshot count across chronological time buckets
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarize(
    mean_error = mean(abs_error),
    n = n()
  )

# Plot mean absolute error across time buckets with group = 1 to connect discrete x categories
ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining until resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Group final-day snapshots into 10-percentage-point probability bins and compute calibration
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_remaining == 0) |>
  mutate(prob_bin = cut(probability, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(prob_bin) |>
  summarize(
    predicted_prob = mean(probability),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n()
  )

# Plot actual YES rate against predicted probability with a 45-degree perfect-calibration line
ggplot(calibration, aes(x = predicted_prob, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts closely track actual outcomes, especially at the extremes",
    subtitle = "Observed YES resolution rate vs. predicted probability across 10-point bins",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES resolution rate",
    size = "Markets",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
